Job Description

The Customer Insights & Data Analytics Lead Data Analyst is a highly experienced technical resource responsible for leading complex analytical initiatives and translating large internal and external data sources into actionable insights that support Ryder’s Marketing team and broader business objectives. This role combines advanced analytical expertise with the ability to lead analytical workstreams and guide projects from concept through delivery. The Lead Data Analyst is responsible for designing and executing complex analyses, integrating data from multiple systems, and developing scalable reporting and analytical solutions. They ensure that insights are clearly communicated to stakeholders and leadership, translating technical findings into meaningful business recommendations. The Lead Data Analyst is expected to proactively identify opportunities to enhance data processes, improve reporting methodologies, and expand the team’s analytical capabilities. They must be comfortable working with large datasets, managing complex analytical requests, and collaborating across the organization with partners in Marketing, Sales, IT, and other business units to drive impactful insights and successful outcomes. The Lead Data Analyst is responsible for planning and executing complex analytical initiatives, including developing project plans, managing timelines, and ensuring successful delivery of key outputs. They proactively communicate progress, challenges, and results to stakeholders and leadership to maintain alignment and drive successful outcomes.

Responsibilities

Lead the design, development, and delivery of advanced dashboards, reporting solutions, and analytical products to support executive leadership and key strategic initiatives. Own project planning, including defining scope, timelines, and deliverables, and provide guidance on complex ad hoc reporting requests to ensure outputs deliver actionable insights.Design, enhance, and oversee scalable reporting frameworks across multiple product lines and business segments, ensuring consistency, usability, and alignment with evolving business needs. Manage associated workstreams and timelines to ensure successful implementation.Lead comprehensive customer and market analyses across Ryder business units, including customer and market sizing, share analysis, growth trends, segmentation, and other advanced analytical initiatives that support Marketing strategy and decision making. Drive these initiatives from planning through execution and delivery.Establish and reinforce best practices for data accuracy and integrity, supporting periodic audits, validation processes, and quality checks to ensure the reliability of reporting and analytical outputs. Serve as a technical leader and steward of the team’s data assets (both owned and unowned), helping organize and enhance data resources, identify issues and opportunities for improvement, and partner with leadership to strengthen the team’s analytical infrastructure.  Lead the acquisition, integration, cleaning, validation, and analysis of data from multiple systems, databases, and tools to support complex analytical initiatives and improve the accessibility and usability of data assets. Plan and coordinate data related activities to align with project timelines and priorities.

Additional Responsibilities

     Performs other duties as assigned.

Detailed oriented with excellent follow-up practicesA strong sense of urgency and commitment to get the job done quickly and with high-level of quality  Capable of multi-tasking, highly organized, with excellent time management skills Demonstrates problem solving skills and the ability to find creative solutions to challenges. Consistently makes connections to account for the bigger picture. Ability to create and maintain professional relationships within all levels of the organization (peers, work groups, customers, supervisors).Work cross-functionally in order to achieve desired results Communicates work to customers and leadership clearly in nontechnical language. Effective written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to interact with management and across business and IT groups Ability to work independently and as a member of a teamPossesses strong technical aptitude

Knowledge

Advanced knowledge of complex query writing using SQL with the ability to join multiple tables, summarizing, grouping, data manipulation, performing analytical functions, etc.Familiarity and knowledge of other programing languages and analytical tools (Python, PowerBI, R, DataBricks, etc.)

About us: Working at Target means helping all families discover the joy of everyday life. We bring that vision to life through our values and culture. Learn more about Target here. Data & Analytics—Business Insights & Analytics Behind one of the world’s best loved brands is a uniquely capable and brilliant team of applied data scientists, engineers and data analysts. The Target Data & Analytics team creates the tools and data products to sustainably educate and enable our business partners to make great data-based decisions at Target. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams to analyze trends, optimize digital strategies, and provide clear recommendations for business growth. The ideal candidate should be comfortable working with large datasets, building scalable reports, and simplifying complex data to enable efficient decision-making. job_highlights.title: Responsibilities
items: This role is responsible for transforming complex cybersecurity data into accurate, actionable insights that support operational decision-making, risk management, regulatory oversight, and executive reporting

The Information Security Data Analyst will work closely with Security Operations, Vulnerability Management, Identity and Access Management, Infrastructure, and Technology Risk teams to develop automated reporting, dashboards, and metrics that provide visibility into the organization's cybersecurity posture

A key focus of this position will be vulnerability management analytics, including the analysis of vulnerability exposure, remediation performance, asset criticality, and compliance with established remediation timelines
Key Responsibilities Cybersecurity Data Analytics & Reporting Collect, analyze, validate, and interpret cybersecurity data from multiple enterprise security platforms
Develop and maintain dashboards, reports, and analytical models that measure cybersecurity risk, operational effectiveness, and control performance
Transform complex technical data into clear, actionable insights for Information Security leadership, executive management, and risk committees
Identify trends, anomalies, emerging risks, and opportunities for improvement across cybersecurity operations
Establish repeatable reporting processes that improve accuracy, consistency, and timeliness
Automate data collection, transformation, reconciliation, and reporting to reduce manual effort
Support the development of cybersecurity key risk indicators (KRIs), key performance indicators (KPIs), and operational metrics
Maintain clear documentation of data sources, metric definitions, calculations, assumptions, and reporting methodologies
Vulnerability Management Analytics Develop and maintain vulnerability reporting across on-premises infrastructure, cloud environments, applications, and enterprise platforms
Analyze vulnerability data from Tenable, ServiceNow Vulnerability Response, and other relevant security tools
Track critical and high-severity vulnerabilities, remediation timelines, aging, exceptions, and exposure beyond established service-level agreements
Correlate vulnerability findings with asset inventories, business criticality, ownership, and operational context to improve risk-based prioritization
Identify recurring vulnerabilities, remediation bottlenecks, data quality issues, and emerging exposure trends
Develop reporting that distinguishes newly discovered vulnerabilities from existing exposure, overdue remediation, and changes resulting from expanded scanning coverage
Partner with infrastructure and application teams to validate vulnerability data, identify remediation owners, and improve reporting accuracy
Support vulnerability governance meetings through preparation of metrics, trend analysis, and executive-level reporting
Develop analytical capabilities to measure remediation progress and assess the effectiveness of vulnerability management activities
Security Metrics & Risk Reporting Support the design, development, and maintenance of Information Security KRIs and KPIs aligned with enterprise risk management requirements
Produce recurring cybersecurity reporting for executive leadership, risk committees, and other governance forums
Analyze trends in security incidents, vulnerability exposure, identity controls, security monitoring, and remediation effectiveness
Establish consistent calculation methodologies, reporting thresholds, and data quality controls
Investigate unexpected changes in metrics and distinguish actual risk increases from changes in detection capabilities, scanning coverage, or data sources
Partner with Technology Risk and other stakeholders to ensure reporting is accurate, traceable, and aligned with approved risk definitions
Prepare supporting analysis and evidence for internal audits, regulatory examinations, and management reviews
Develop historical trending and comparative analysis to help leadership evaluate the effectiveness of security investments and operational improvements
Data Integration, Automation & Visualization Develop automated data pipelines and reporting solutions using SQL, Python, Power BI, APIs, and other approved enterprise technologies
Integrate data from cybersecurity platforms and cloud security tools
Build interactive dashboards that allow stakeholders to analyze security metrics by business service, asset criticality, technology platform, ownership, and risk category
Perform data cleansing, normalization, reconciliation, and validation across multiple systems
Identify inconsistencies between security tools and authoritative asset or configuration management data
Create reusable datasets, reporting templates, and standardized analytical models
Work with technology teams to improve data accessibility, reliability, and reporting automation
Apply appropriate data access controls and handling practices to sensitive cybersecurity information
Data Quality & Continuous Improvement Establish controls to ensure cybersecurity reporting is complete, accurate, consistent, and reproducible
Document data lineage, business rules, transformations, and calculation logic supporting key security metrics
Investigate data discrepancies and collaborate with system owners to resolve underlying issues
Identify opportunities to simplify reporting processes and eliminate redundant or manual activities
Develop quality assurance checks to detect missing records, duplicate findings, incorrect asset classifications, and inconsistent remediation statuses
Recommend improvements to cybersecurity data models, reporting architecture, and analytical capabilities
Support continuous improvement initiatives that strengthen the organization's ability to measure and manage cybersecurity risk
Cross-Functional Collaboration Partner with Information Security teams to understand operational processes, reporting requirements, and cybersecurity risk drivers
Collaborate with Infrastructure, Cloud Engineering, Application Development, Enterprise Architecture, and Technology Risk teams
Translate technical findings into concise summaries that communicate business impact and recommended actions
Support leadership in responding to ad hoc analytical requests, regulatory inquiries, and emerging cybersecurity issues
Present analytical findings and explain trends, assumptions, and limitations to technical and nontechnical stakeholders
Work is generally performed within an office environment, with standard office equipment available
Candidates will report to the office three days each week
